additional_info.subject: Re: ID0414463-DC/Si-D/SA-[MP / R8 170002361] Unable to remote start CRM:01811000736
additional_info.body:
Hello Arjun,
Thank you for your question. The appearance of the capitalized ID in the logs during authentication could be related to the system's formatting behavior, though it may vary depending on specific configurations.
Regarding remote start, it is supported in the following cases:
When the charging session ends normally, and the vehicle remains plugged in (state B).
If authorization fails, we transition to state B to allow for a RemoteStart request to initiate a transaction.
The functionality is dependent on maintaining a stable communication link between the vehicle and charger.
If you have encountered the same behavior, please feel free to share more details with us, and we will investigate further.
Should you have any other questions, don't hesitate to reach out.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Ankita Khobare

additional_info.subject: Re: ID0414463-DC/Si-D/SA-[MP / R8 170002361] Unable to remote start CRM:01811000736
additional_info.body:
Hello Arjun,
We are not entirely sure why the
idTag is
capitalized during the "Authorize" request from the charger. It could be due to the charger’s internal formatting behavior, where the
idTag
is automatically converted to uppercase before being sent. If this issue occurs again, please let us know, and we will investigate further with our experts. However, as of now, this does not seem to be a significant issue.
Regarding your other questions:
"System's formatting behavior":
By "system's formatting behavior," we are referring to the internal
charging station system.
This could be due to the charger’s internal formatting behavior,
Specific configurations:
These may involve settings like case formatting for
idTags
, authentication rules, and communication settings. We’d need to check the charger’s configuration to confirm the exact setup.
State B approach for RemoteStart:
State B refers to the
charging state
. If the charger is in State B, it will begin charging as soon as the
StartTransaction
command is received after the
RemoteStart
request.
We hope this satisfies your queries. If the issue arises again, please don’t hesitate to reach out
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Ankita Khobare
